## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — mixed signals with narrow leadership and weak breadth; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Energy and Materials are ABOVE TREND while Technology is broadly BELOW TREND; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +20.80%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: DOW (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing modest support: D (coastal wind) noted in news.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: GOOGL (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -8.60%) BELOW TREND. Industrials and Consumer Discretionary also lag: CAT (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -10.15%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -6.71% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND; EOG (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +20.80%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND; MO (1W: +5.83% | 1M: -1.30%) RECOVERY. Leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PLTR (1W: -14.48% | 1M: +0.26%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -14.31% | 1M: -14.42%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -37.90%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +20.80%) ABOVE TREND; watch RECOVERY names with 1W/1M divergence: MO (1W: +5.83% | 1M: -1.30%) RECOVERY, KHC (1W: +5.33% | 1M: -7.70%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +5.07% | 1M: -20.52%) RECOVERY — minor divergence signal across cyclical names.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak and broadly BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.64%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -13.55%) BELOW TREND. Sector momentum is negative; watch for continued leadership vacuum.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft with several leaders BELOW TREND: JPM (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -5.50%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND — breadth remains weak in the sector.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak: PFE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.39%) RECOVERY, BMY (1W: +4.79% | 1M: -4.23%) RECOVERY while UNH (1W: -2.88% | 1M: -10.04%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -15.72%) BELOW TREND — defensive names showing isolated strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and Materials exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership; reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing cluster weakness (GOOGL, META, MSFT). Monitor RECOVERY setups in Consumer Staples (MO, KHC) as tactical entries for already-positioned allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.31% | 1M: -14.42%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +4.92% | 1M: +15.24%) showing clear strength; Materials (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -6.88%) also leading. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -6.81%) and Industrials (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -11.64%) remain at risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND for failure to reclaim short-term momentum; XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND sustaining weekly gains is a continuation trigger; AAPL (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.64%) BELOW TREND — support tests; JPM (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -5.50%) BELOW TREND — watch for breakdown vs. 1M trend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (+60): Exxon upbeat on best-quarter outlook — XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming price action. MO (+60): FDA pilot for nicotine pouches — MO (1W: +5.83% | 1M: -1.30%) RECOVERY, sentiment driving short-term lift but 1M still negative (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-60): Breakup bill and lawsuit headlines — UNH (1W: -2.88% | 1M: -10.04%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirms downside. META (-45): Regulatory/legal overhang in Australia — META (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming sell-off. LRCX (-45): Supply-chain risk headlines — LRCX (1W: -14.31% | 1M: -14.42%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming deep weakness. WMT (-50): facility closure headlines — WMT (1W: +2.30% | 1M: -3.28%) RECOVERY, bearish sentiment diverges from 1W strength.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style favored. XOM (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: Technology cluster remains BELOW TREND and negative sentiment around UNH/META — watch divergent RECOVERY pops in MO/WMT for confirmation.
